rows.name: Salary net2m
rows.source_condition_check: Supplied net salary; only first two taxable slices needed; defective first endpoint and currentness remain held.

rows.name: Individual business minimum
rows.source_condition_check: Non-agriculture, no exemption, 120m turnover; compare liabilities rather than sum.

rows.name: Company profit dominates
rows.source_condition_check: Ordinary baseline, no exemption or credit; no double tax.

rows.name: Agricultural loss minimum
rows.source_condition_check: Loss gives no profit tax; 0.3% produces 180,000 below 300,000 floor.

rows.name: Foreign fee cap
rows.source_condition_check: Assumes proof of reality/normality and no other disallowance; 20% base before expense.

rows.name: Half threshold
rows.source_condition_check: Exactly half fails more-than-half test; comparable actual tax amounts, no list/treaty inference.

rows.name: Foreign service WHT
rows.source_condition_check: Covered gross foreign service fee; no treaty reduction or gross-up; VAT/deduction separate.

rows.name: Departure guarantee
rows.source_condition_check: Only permanent certificate for manager of enterprise under audit; guarantee alone does not ensure clearance.

rows.name: VAT net
rows.source_condition_check: Ordinary 19% domestic supply and supplied eligible inputs; no withholding or adjustments.

rows.name: Direct attribution
rows.source_condition_check: Exempt-only 95,000 excluded; 60% only on shared inputs; difference 19,000.

rows.name: SARL or SA cash
rows.source_condition_check: All cash, default minima, no national override or stricter statutes; conditional default, not authenticated CAR floor.

rows.name: SARL mixed
rows.source_condition_check: In-kind paid fully, cash half; valuation and national formalities remain held.

rows.name: Payroll annual to monthly
rows.source_condition_check: Fixed full-year payroll with correctly computed annual IRPP; no implied CNSS rate.

rows.name: Five or sixworkers
rows.source_condition_check: Unchanged workforce; five qualifies for quarterly remittance, six monthly; withholding continues in both.

rows.name: General25%penalty
rows.source_condition_check: Applicable paragraph established, no fraud; no automatic flat/special cumulative fine.

rows.name: Visa vs generalfine
rows.source_condition_check: Two established breaches; alternative classifications, not summed.

rows.name: Rentalvaluefloor
rows.source_condition_check: Non-exempt individual; rental-value floor, 40% allowance, rounded base, 15% above minimum.

rows.name: Individual or company
rows.source_condition_check: Identical non-exempt rental value; IS classification controls; other entity taxes separate.
